title: Good Vibrations Report on the DNA Quadruplex Binding of an Excited State Amplified Ruthenium Polypyridyl IR Probe.
authors: Stitch, Mark; Avagliano, Davide; Graczyk, Daniel; Clark, Ian P; Gonzalez, Leticia; Towrie, Michael; Quinn, Susan J
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
one_liner_zh: 该文结合TRIR光谱与分子动力学模拟研究钌配合物与G-四链体DNA的结合位点与相互作用，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（非TF-DNA）且方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模。
abstract: The nitrile containing Ru(II)polypyridyl complex [Ru(phen)(2)(11,12-dCN-dppz)](2+) (1) is shown to act as a sensitive infrared probe of G-quadruplex (G4) structures. UV-visible absorption spectroscopy reveals enantiomer sensitive binding for the hybrid htel(K) and antiparallel htel(Na) G4s formed by the human telomer sequence d[AG(3)(TTAG(3))(3)]. Time-resolved infrared (TRIR) of 1 upon 400 nm excitation indicates dominant interactions with the guanine bases in the case of Lambda-1/htel(K), Delta-1/htel(K), and Lambda-1/htel(Na) binding, whereas Delta-1/htel(Na) binding is associated with interactions with thymine and adenine bases in the loop. The intense nitrile transient at 2232 cm(-1) undergoes a linear shift to lower frequency as the solution hydrogen bonding environment decreases in DMSO/water mixtures. This shift is used as a sensitive reporter of the nitrile environment within the binding pocket. The lifetime of 1 in D(2)O (ca. 100 ps) is found to increase upon DNA binding, and monitoring of the nitrile and ligand transients as well as the diagnostic DNA bleach bands shows that this increase is related to greater protection from the solvent environment. Molecular dynamics simulations together with binding energy calculations identify the most favorable binding site for each system, which are in excellent agreement with the observed TRIR solution study. This study shows the power of combining the environmental sensitivity of an infrared (IR) probe in its excited state with the TRIR DNA "site effect" to gain important information about the binding site of photoactive agents and points to the potential of such amplified IR probes as sensitive reporters of biological environments.
abstract_zh: 含腈基的Ru(II)多吡啶配合物[Ru(phen)₂(11,12-dCN-dppz)]²⁺ (1)被证明可作为G-四链体 (G-quadruplex, G4) 结构的灵敏红外探针。紫外-可见吸收光谱揭示了由人类端粒序列d[AG₃(TTAG₃)₃]形成的杂合型htel(K)和反平行htel(Na) G4s对映体选择性结合。在400 nm激发下，1的时间分辨红外 (time-resolved infrared, TRIR) 光谱表明，Lambda-1/htel(K)、Delta-1/htel(K)和Lambda-1/htel(Na)结合情况下主要与鸟嘌呤碱基相互作用，而Delta-1/htel(Na)结合则与环区中的胸腺嘧啶和腺嘌呤碱基相关。位于2232 cm⁻¹的强腈基瞬态信号在DMSO/水混合物中随溶液氢键环境减弱而线性向低频移动。该位移被用作结合口袋内腈基环境的灵敏报告器。1在D₂O中的寿命（约100 ps）在DNA结合后增加，对腈基和配体瞬态信号以及诊断性DNA漂白带的监测表明，这种增加与溶剂环境提供的更大保护有关。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟结合结合能计算确定了每个系统最有利的结合位点，与观察到的TRIR溶液研究结果高度一致。本研究展示了将红外 (infrared, IR) 探针激发态的环境敏感性与TRIR DNA“位点效应”相结合，以获取光活性剂结合位点重要信息的强大能力，并指出了此类放大红外探针作为生物环境灵敏报告器的潜力。
